verdict.rationale: Grafana OSS is a well-known self-hostable open-source product (github.com/grafana/grafana), with docs and CLI supporting local installation and administration; community comments confirm real-world self-hosted/on-prem use. However, licensing concerns (AGPL) create friction for some self-hosters. Missing for 10: explicit first-party self-hosting/installation guide citation in this pack, and independent hands-on confirmation of a smooth self-host setup free of the license-related organizational blockers raised in community evidence.
